page: Amazon Web Services c9g.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64), this instance features 48 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz, with a 1:1 mapping of vCPUs to physical cores. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which offloads virtualization functions to dedicated hardware to maximize CPU performance availability. It does not include local NVMe storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM-based architecture and dedicated core allocation offer high compute density and predictable performance per resource unit compared to traditional x86 architectures. This profile is designed for compute-bound workloads that benefit from high single-threaded performance and dedicated CPU resources, such as high-performance computing, batch processing, video encoding, and distributed analytics.
